name: animated-tabs

light.primitive-font-mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace

docs: Free Wensity component. Installs to @components/wensity/animated-tabs.tsx. For Pro components and updates, use pnpm dlx wensity@latest add animated-tabs.
